name: WOKA Whitewater Park
ownership: Grand River Dam Authority (built with the City of Siloam Springs; Walton Family Foundation funding)
facilities: Whitewater course with a large parking area (per AW). Commercial use prohibited and no alcohol (2025 GRDA guide).
description: HELD. Excluded as a planner endpoint: a whitewater course at the old Lake Frances spillway, just above the dam remnant. Its sources disagree. The AGFC Public Use Facilities layer (objectid 25308) gives 36.130578, -94.562524. The AGFC water-trail page link gives 36.133889, -94.566111, 489 m away. American Whitewater's WOKA put-in gives 36.13201, -94.56405, 210 m from the first and 279 m from the second. The official site gives only a street address (474986 Twin Falls Rd, Watts, OK). Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 2.6 (+47.2).

name: Watts Public Access Area (US-59 bridge)
ownership: GRDA Scenic Rivers public access area ('US 59 Illinois River Bridge Crossing Access Area', OAC 300:40-2-3(h)); land ownership unverified
facilities: Not verified. No alcohol (OAC 300:40-2-3(h); 2025 GRDA guide).
description: Recommended upstream endpoint, below the Lake Frances dam remnant. The pin is the US-59 river crossing: the midpoint of the twin NBI structures 281960 (NB) and 282160 (SB). GRDA's rule names the access area by this crossing. American Whitewater places the launch 'at the bridge on river right' at 36.130173, -94.571497, 114 m north of the pin. Confirm the parking/launch on imagery and move the pin onto it before approval. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 3.1 (+47.2).
road_access: US-59 crosses the river here, about 1 mile north of Watts.

name: Carnes Ford Public Access Area
ownership: GRDA Scenic Rivers public access area ('Carnes Ford Area', OAC 300:40-2-3(h)); land ownership unverified
facilities: Low-water slab crossing, marked 'Dangerous during high water' by GRDA. No alcohol.
description: HELD: no agency coordinate. Two non-agency sources agree within 30 m: American Whitewater 'Carnes Ford River Access' (36.14117, -94.666928; river right) and OSM ford node 8968644307 (36.1410581, -94.6672303). Both measure at Eddy mile 57.77, 11-18 m from the line. A GRDA or ODWC coordinate would make this pin-grade. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 10.4 (+47.2).

name: Chewey Bridge
ownership: Adair County road bridge (Chewey Road / E0630; NBI 136820, owner code 02 county highway agency)
facilities: None verified. USGS gauge 07196090 (Illinois River at Chewey) is at the bridge.
description: Landmark only, NOT a planner endpoint. The 2025 GRDA guide shows Chewey Bridge as a landmark, not a green public access area. American Whitewater lists an access on river left, but public launch rights and parking are unverified. The pin is the bridge itself (NBI fields), corroborated by OSM bridge way 233785862 (3 m away). Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 23.6 (+47.2).

name: Round Hollow Public Access Area
ownership: GRDA Scenic Rivers public access area (ODWC-agreement site per 2021 coverage; land ownership unverified)
facilities: 28 reservable primitive campsites (R-1 to R-28, $14/night) in GRDA's reservation system. American Whitewater notes a long gravel bar used as the launch. Restrooms not verified. Alcohol allowed (beer and wine, 21+, non-glass).
description: GRDA public access area on river right and the end of Commercial Float Area One. Outfitters use it as a long-trip launch. The pin is GRDA's own site coordinate from its Scenic Rivers reservation system. American Whitewater's access point is 29 m away. The legacy GNIS park point (OSM node 357403692) sits 277 m south and is treated as a centroid. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 27.7 (+47.2); measured 75.41.
road_access: OK-10 (Illinois River Scenic Drive) at North Round Hollow Road.
parking_info: Not verified; GRDA campground area beside OK-10.

name: Stunkard Public Access Area
ownership: GRDA Scenic Rivers public access area (ODWC-agreement site per 2021 coverage; land ownership unverified)
facilities: Not verified. OAC 300:40-3-2 allows beer and wine here; the 2025 guide's alcohol list omits it.
description: HELD: the only coordinate is non-agency, and it conflicts with GRDA's mileage. American Whitewater gives 36.088687, -94.837319 (river right) at Eddy mile 75.97, 892 m (0.56 river mile) below GRDA's Round Hollow pin. GRDA's mileage puts Stunkard 0.3 mile below Round Hollow. Stunkard is not in GRDA's reservation system, and no GNIS or OSM feature exists. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 28.0 (+47.2).

name: Peavine Hollow Public Access Area
ownership: GRDA Scenic Rivers public access area (ODWC-agreement site per 2021 coverage; land ownership unverified)
facilities: 6 reservable primitive campsites (P-1 to P-6, $14/night) in GRDA's reservation system. Restrooms not verified. Alcohol allowed (beer and wine, 21+, non-glass).
description: GRDA public access area on river right, used by outfitters as a long-trip launch. The pin is GRDA's own site coordinate from its Scenic Rivers reservation system. American Whitewater's access point is 28 m away, and the GNIS park point (OSM node 357401613) is 28 m away. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 32.4 (+47.2); measured 79.67.
road_access: Directly off OK-10 (Illinois River Scenic Drive).

name: Edmondson Public Access Area (Combs Bridge)
ownership: GRDA Scenic Rivers public access area (land ownership unverified)
description: HELD: no agency coordinate for the access itself. American Whitewater gives 36.031363, -94.912292 (river left), 143 m from the 2015 Combs Bridge (NBI 308360, N4545, 36.032222, -94.911111). GRDA's mileage puts Edmondson 0.3 mile above 'New Combs Bridge' (RM 36.2 vs 36.5). OAC 300:40-1-5 puts Comb's Bridge at RM 36.1. Which bank and how far from the bridge needs GRDA or imagery. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 36.2 (+47.2); the bridge measures at 83.39.

name: No Head Hollow Public Access Area
ownership: GRDA Scenic Rivers public access area (ODWC-agreement site per 2021 coverage; land ownership unverified)
facilities: 3 reservable primitive campsites (N-1 to N-3, $14/night) in GRDA's reservation system. Restrooms not verified. Alcohol allowed.
description: GRDA public access area on river right. It is the boundary between the upper and lower sections and the end of Commercial Float Area Two. The pin is GRDA's own site coordinate from its Scenic Rivers reservation system. American Whitewater's access point is 26 m away, and the GNIS point (OSM node 357399759) is 56 m away. GRDA's store lists it as 'No Head Public Access Area' under the URL slug 'todd-public-access-area'; the separate Todd product is '-1'. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 41.5 (+47.2); measured 88.94.
road_access: Directly off OK-10 (Illinois River Scenic Drive).

name: Todd Public Access Area
ownership: GRDA Scenic Rivers public access area (land ownership unverified)
facilities: 3 reservable primitive campsites (T-1 to T-3, $14/night) in GRDA's reservation system. Restrooms not verified. No alcohol; commercial use prohibited (2025 GRDA guide; OAC 300:40-2-3(h)).
description: GRDA public access area on river left. Commercial use is prohibited, so outfitters do not launch here. The pin is GRDA's own site coordinate from its Scenic Rivers reservation system. American Whitewater's access point is 39 m away. No GNIS feature exists. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 47.0 (+47.2); measured 94.31.
road_access: End of North Oakdale Drive (OSM way 14707415), east of Tahlequah.

name: Echota Public Access Area
ownership: GRDA Scenic Rivers public access area (ODWC-agreement site per 2021 coverage; land ownership unverified)
facilities: Not verified. OAC 300:40-3-2 allows beer and wine here; the 2025 guide's alcohol list omits it.
description: HELD: no agency coordinate, and the two leads are 267 m apart. The legacy GNIS park point (OSM node 357391240) is at 35.9437019, -94.9141214, Eddy mile 100.21, 98 m from the line. American Whitewater's 'Echota Bend' access (river left, at the 90-degree bend) is at 35.942703, -94.911419, Eddy mile 100.11, 71 m from the line. Echota is not in GRDA's reservation system. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 53.2 (+47.2).

name: US Highway 62 Bridge Access
ownership: GRDA Scenic Rivers public access area ('US 62 Bridge Access on the Illinois River', OAC 300:40-2-3(h)); land ownership unverified
description: Common take-out near the Tahlequah outfitter cluster. The pin is the US-62 river crossing: the midpoint of the twin NBI structures 250090 and 250110 (record lat/long fields). GRDA's rule names the access by this bridge. OSM bridge way 164654141 is 27 m away. American Whitewater's access point (35.926302, -94.924289) is 70 m east. Confirm the parking/launch and bank on imagery, and move the pin onto it before approval. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 55.1 (+47.2); measured 101.85. The local GRDA offset here is about 46.75.
road_access: US-62 / OK-51 crossing of the Illinois River, about 2 miles northeast of Tahlequah.

name: Murrell Home Rd Public Access
ownership: US Army Corps of Engineers (per the 2025 GRDA guide: 'US Army Corps of Engineers own/manage Murrell Home, Boy Scout Hole and Welling Bridge Access areas', 918-487-5252)
facilities: Not verified. GRDA marks it 'Dangerous during high water'.
description: HELD: no USACE coordinate found. It is absent from the Tulsa District recreation-features service, the USACE recreation-area polygons and recreation.gov. AW lists no point for it, and OSM has nothing tagged there. The endpoint flag stays false until a USACE source confirms launch and parking. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 62.0 (+47.2) = 109.2. That is past the Baron Fork mouth (Eddy 108.70), where the stored line now ends. GRDA puts Baron Fork 0.5 mile below this access, so the true position is about Eddy 108.2.

name: Horseshoe Bend Public Use Area
ownership: US Army Corps of Engineers, Tenkiller Ferry Lake (recreation area 202698 'HORESHOE BEND', Tulsa District)
facilities: USACE boat ramp, concrete, 1 launch lane (one lane closed), no user fee, no courtesy dock; crushed-stone ramp parking (USACE SWT data, 2021).
description: HELD only because it lies off the stored river: the coordinate is verified. The USACE Tulsa District boat-ramp feature is at 35.821418, -94.903206. American Whitewater's 'Horseshoe Bend Take-Out' is 58 m away, and the GNIS point (OSM node 357395037) is 40 m away. Measured Eddy mile is 111.79, inside Tenkiller Ferry Lake and below the Baron Fork confluence (108.70), where the stored line now ends. It is excluded from the corridor. Restore lat/lon only if the river is extended into the lake. Expected mile converted from GRDA mile 65.6 (+47.2); the local offset below Baron Fork is about 46.2.
